programmes.d: Appa and Umma come up with a new sleeping arrangement. Jung pursues a new career and tries to involve Janet. Meanwhile, Shannon and Kimchee discover a new, slightly terrifying side of Terence.
Egos soar out of control when Sabrina uses magic to become a rock star.
When Sabrina switches personalities with Libby, she uses her magic and newly found popularity.
A talking car causes Sabrina a big headache.
Public speaking seems like a breeze for Sabrina after coming face-to-face with her fears in the Other Realm.

Phil (Donald Faison) is nervous when Holly (Kristen Johnston) starts dating his top client - basketball player Kevin Tyler (Amar'e Stoudemire). Haskell (Wayne Knight) lures Stuart (David Alan Basche) into the world of sports betting.
The gang's relationships are thrown out of whack when Holly discovers there's way more to Stuart than meets the eye.
When the guys can't resolve their differences, Holly sends the three of them to couples' therapy, where they discover that Holly is the problem.
Holly takes Haskell on a practice date, and finds herself blown away by Haskell's hidden talents. Stuart embarrasses Phil when he tries way too hard to fit in with Phil's friends.

Chris agrees to help a classmate, Angel improve his grades if Angel will help him get the attention of Chris' latest crush, Maria. Rochelle reluctantly befriends an ex-con, Peaches who has moved back into the neighborhood, but her good deed backfires.

Chris is on cloud nine when a cute girl, Jenise Huckstable, invites him to the Tattaglia Homecoming Dance. However, his nerves take a turn for the worse when her father, Dr. Huxtable, wants Chris to come over to the house to meet him before the dance.
When Julius and Rochelle decide to raise Mr. Omar's rent, Mr. Omar demands they bring the apartment up to code and moves in with Chris' family until the repairs are done.
Chris realizes that by helping the school's star running back and his friends with homework he is allowed to hang out with the cool kids. Greg tries to make him see that it's a bad idea.
The cast and crew of Hot in Cleveland break down how the show comes together throughout the week, from the table read to rehearsals to shooting in front of a live audience.
Victoria hopes an unearthed Lincoln letter will distract from her Mrs. Ladypants commercial airing in the U.S., while Joy exaggerates her breast size over CB radio.
Victoria gets her soap opera creator and costar onboard to resurrect the show as an app, with blatant product placements.
After their selfish behavior creates a rift between hairdressers Christopher and Pierre, the women have had enough of living with each other.
Joy finds out she's a grandmother, Elka gets the upper hand with Pierre, Victoria lands a prime film role, and Melanie is hired by PR firm co-owner Chloe.
Chloe has Melanie spy on Alec, Victoria is resistant to gaining weight for her Woody Allen film role, and Joy is inspired by her infant grandson Wilbur to go back to college.
Sabrina’s charitable magic turns out to be anything but a good deed.
Magical ambition shows its dark side when Harvey drops out of school to become an industrial tycoon.
Mr. Kraft’s ex-wife returns to win him back, but Zelda isn’t going to let him go without a fight.
Purchasing a fake ID in the Other Realm causes Sabrina’s magic to become fake as well.
It’s Valentine’s Day, and Sabrina must help two people fall in love or suffer Cupid’s wrath.
Salem's return to human form is short-lived, thanks to Roland the Troll and Sabrina's unknowing wishes.
